name: Pixel Art
description: Chunky pixels, a checker ground, and square corners.
bestFor: Games and retro tools that should look drawn on a grid.
promptFragment: Visual style: Pixel Art. Use a visible pixel grid, square corners, a 4px black contour, a hard 4px shadow, and a monospace face. Colors are flat and limited, like a sprite palette. Avoid blur, gradients, subpixel softness, and large radii. Keep text readable: meet WCAG 2.2 AA contrast (4.5:1) against the surface the text actually sits on. https://www.w3.org/WAI/WCAG22/Understanding/contrast-minimum.html
